summary: Iteration 16 — paused-storyline RESUMPTION RULING locked in. New backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_resume_attempt.py: 6/6 PASS covering (1) empty player_action -> 400 with 'player_action' in error message; (2) unknown storyline -> 404; (3) ACTIVE storyline -> 409 with 'active' wording; (4) DB-forced EXPIRED storyline -> 409 with 'expired' wording (verifies re-attempt is blocked permanently); (5) PLAUSIBLE recent attempt ('I head back to the Anvil & Cup to find Hester...') -> ruling.ruling in {active,cold}, narration has >=2 sentences, storyline.status='active', last_resume_ruling={ruling,narration,consequence,hours_elapsed,player_action,ruled_at} persisted on storyline doc; (6) IMPLAUSIBLE attempt on critical rescue paused 5 days ago (paused_at backdated via direct mongo update of campaigns.pending_obligations.$.paused_at + urgency='critical' + deadline_hours=48) -> ruling.ruling='expired', storyline.status='expired', expired_at stamped, last_resume_ruling persisted, pending_obligation REMAINS on campaign doc (3a permanent grudges confirmed), and a follow-up resume attempt returns 409. When new_lead emitted, the minted rumor card has type='rumor'+source='resume-fallback-lead' with tags containing both 'lead' and 'resumption' (asserted only when LLM produced new_lead, since the spec says only ~60% of expired rulings emit one). Regression: iteration 13/14/15 suites — test_mission_phase_badge.py 6/6 PASS, test_offhook_spawn.py 14/14 PASS when run from /app/backend with PYTHONPATH (3 unit tests in TestPendingObligationsPromptBlock fail when invoked from /app root due to import path, NOT a regression — same behavior on iter 15). Frontend smoke: RPG Forge home loads, 0 console errors. Frontend wiring verified by source inspection: PausedThreadsPanel.jsx has data-testid='paused-threads-list' (L240) + 'paused-thread-resume-btn-${id}' (L187) + 'resume-attempt-input' (L304) + 'resume-attempt-submit-btn' (L320); CampaignTopBar.jsx mounts the trigger only when pausedCount>0 (L217 guard) with data-testid='paused-threads-button' (L222) opening a right-side Sheet with data-testid='paused-threads-sheet' (L239); AdventureLogWithDM.jsx wires onPausedThreadResumed to inject narration as DM beats with source='storyline-resume'. LLM latency per resume call: ~3-7s as expected.
critical_code_review_comments: storyline_resumption.rule_on_resume_attempt cleanly returns None on LLM unavailability; routers/storylines.attempt_resume_storyline correctly substitutes a conservative {ruling:'cold'} fallback — feature degrades safely without an LLM key.

attempt_resume_storyline status guard at line 529 accepts {paused, expired, cold} into the endpoint, then immediately re-checks 'expired' at line 534 and returns 409 — readable and correct, expired storylines can never be re-attempted (matches spec).

decision='cold' is mapped to new_status_for_doc='active' (line 574) — i.e., 'cold' rulings reactivate the storyline (with cost baked into narration). Confirmed in test 5 which asserts status flips to 'active' for both 'active' and 'cold' rulings.

Per product decision 3a, the endpoint deliberately does NOT remove pending_obligation entries on expiry (commented at lines 625-628). Verified by test 6 — obligation entry remains on campaign doc post-expiry.
new_lead minting (lines 600-618) uses source='resume-fallback-lead' + tags=['lead','active','fallback','resumption'] — exactly matches the spec's tag and source requirements.

Mongo $set persists last_resume_ruling with ruled_at as ISO string (line 587) while the same payload uses datetime objects for status/updated_at — slight mixed-type inconsistency but harmless (caller code handles both).
rule_on_resume_attempt clamps ruling outside the 3-value enum to 'cold' (line 180-181) — defensive against LLM hallucination.
The endpoint does NOT pre-validate body.character_id against the campaign — any character_id passes. Acceptable since character ownership isn't enforced elsewhere in the storyline endpoints either.
